name: 13078 · Jamesville, NY
findings: ZIP 13078 (Jamesville) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13078 (Jamesville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13078 (Jamesville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
